pro_course_detail.description:
Improve your current writing project and your ability to write in English at the same time.

A native speaker who is also a writing expert, can see things in your writing that may be impossible for you to see.

You have a unique voice and I will help you express it the best you can, while keeping in mind your specific readership and context.

Here's how it works: 

Send me your document and I will:

• Correct errors both grammatical and idiomatic (of course)
• Improve fluency and readability while retaining your personal style
• Improve structure and clarity (to strengthen your arguments)
• Adapt word choice to setting 
• Review citations and formatting

All kinds of writing!
• University admissions essays
• Academic writing
• Presentations & speeches
• Letters & emails
• CVs & portfolios
• Creative writing
• Etc.

Your text will show all changes I have made, and if significant structural revisions are needed, I will send you the new version in a separate document.

One class = ±500 words of text. Your text will be returned within 48 hours of reception. 

Your text must be in .docx, .odt, or .pages format.

Note that there will be *no videoconference*. However, you can always book a conversation class to discuss your writing.

Confidence in Communication – Overcome hesitation and learn strategies for expressing yourself clearly and effectively.
Course Structure:

Tailored Lessons – Each session is adapted to your level, needs, and learning goals.
Real-World Scenarios – Learn English in practical contexts like ordering food, asking for directions, making small talk, and more.
Interactive & Engaging Activities – Role-plays, listening exercises, Q&A sessions, and storytelling to keep learning dynamic.
Support & Feedback – Get corrections and guidance to improve your accuracy and confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn English With Conversation!
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to English class! This is the general class for students to take. Here, we will learn all about American Grammar, American Pronunciation, and American Vocabulary. Have a real conversation with a native, and I will check what you know, and what you need to learn! And we can talk about anything!

This class is not very formal, but it is effective. I won’t give you useless activities or waste your time. Only what you need. You’re going to speak, and speak a lot!

This class is almost 100% focused on speaking, with some reading for material. I do not focus on writing at all. All materials are free, this is a real course.

As we continue, you’ll be able to see your improvement. I’ll give you a lot of time to talk, and I’ll be listening for errors. The most important job I have is to correct your errors, and show you why they’re wrong. I’m dedicated to making sure your English is the same as mine, as native as possible.

In this class I use grammar books, pictures, articles, lists, and many more materials to help you understand the best way possible.

Let’s learn together! I’m looking forward to building our English relationship.

Please understand that my time is very important so I cannot allow lesson cancellations.

I will wait 15 minutes for the student to arrive. If the student arrives more than 15 minutes late to the lesson, the lesson will be marked as complete. I can not guarantee that I will be available after 15 minutes but I will try. Communicate with me to let me know, and I will wait.

Please be aware and responsible for your scheduled lessons.
